lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's forty-eight? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 48? Nope!

lines.text: The rectangle is twelve by eight, and M is the midpoint of the top.
lines.caption: The rectangle is 12 by 8, and M is the midpoint of the top.

lines.text: What's the area of the shaded shape, A P M D?
lines.caption: What's the area of the shaded shape, APMD?

lines.text: Start with the big triangle A C D. It's half the rectangle: forty-eight.
lines.caption: Start with the big triangle ACD. It's half the rectangle: 48.

lines.text: But it misses one corner, triangle P C M.
lines.caption: But it misses one corner, triangle PCM.

lines.text: It's half as wide as the triangle below it, so half as tall: eight over three.
lines.caption: It's half as wide as the triangle below it, so half as tall: 8/3.

lines.text: Six times eight over three is sixteen. Half of that is eight.
lines.caption: 6 times 8/3 is 16. Half of that is 8.

lines.text: Forty-eight was the trap. It keeps the corner.
lines.caption: 48 was the trap. It keeps the corner.

lines.text: Did you get forty? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 40? Tell me below!
